inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: An Indiana judge blocked a law restricting abortion after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened people’s ability to obtain abortions in line with their sincerely held religious beliefs. That matters: the state shouldn’t impose one religious or political view on everyone, especially when doing so limits people’s bodily autonomy and access to care. LifeNews.com’s “killing babies” framing turns a legal dispute over religious freedom into inflammatory rhetoric rather than engaging with the rights at stake.
